scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind digital devices and peripherals.
Input device: sends information into a computer. Output device: shows or plays results.
Storage device: keeps digital files. Processor: helps follow computing instructions. Peripheral: is an extra device connected to a computer.
In a small group, draw or safely examine pictures of input device, output device and storage device. Explain one real-life use for each in Ghana.
